note: Every source behind the benchmark: where it came from, at which revision, under what license, and what (if anything) of it is stored in this repository. Licenses are as reported by the source's own repository or registry page on 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-14; none was checked by a lawyer. A source is vendored only when what is stored is derived (keys, names, flags, digests) and the license allows redistribution with attribution. AGPL-3.0 sources are not vendored at all: bench/fetch/fetch.mjs downloads them at a pinned commit and refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs from bench/fetch/manifest.json.
